candidates.title: Music by JS Bach arranged by Suzanne Dicker for Cello Quartet, and more…￼
candidates.description:
Suzanne Dicker’s Arrangements of Works by JS Bach, performed by The Creative Bach Cello Ensemble at Trinity Church in Princeton, New Jersey during Lent 2024 .￼
The sheet music for these arrangements can be downloaded for free from 
https://imslp.org/wiki/Category:Dicker,_Suzanne
and
https://www.learningthecello.com/free-cello-ensemble-music.php
Cellists: Peter Brooks, Suzanne Dicker, Katrina Marie Kormanski, Elina Lang, Ted McClure.

Flute: John Lane, Soprano: Samantha Lax, Mezzo soprano: Melissa Fajardo, Tenor: Michael Martin, Bass: Matt Marinelli, Organ: Connor Fluharty

00:00 Bach Goldberg Variation 22
2:48 Trust in the Lord based on BWV 934 and Proverbs 3:5-6
5:37 Prelude 18 from WTC vol. 1 (with recomposed bars by Suzanne Dicker)
7:50 Three-Part Invention #3 
9:34 Prelude 19 from WTC vol. 1
11:32 Two-Part Invention #9 in F minor
13:52 Prelude in F major BWV 928
15:36 Gute Nacht from Motet BWV 227
18:42 Prelude #22 from WTC vol. 1
21:06 Air from Orchestral Suite #3
25:11 Prelude 18 from WTC vol. 1 (Original bars of JS Bach)
27:18 Chorale from Cantata 140, arranged by Wendy Bissenger for cello quartet
